data.name: cl_err_400
data.value: One or more fields are not valid.

data.name: cl_err_401
data.value: Those sign-in details are not correct.
data.comment: Deliberately identical for a wrong password, an unknown account and a deactivated account.

data.name: cl_err_401_missing
data.value: You are not signed in.

data.name: cl_err_403
data.value: Your role does not allow this.

data.name: cl_err_404
data.value: {0} {1} was not found.

data.name: cl_err_409
data.value: That conflicts with something already recorded.

data.name: cl_err_409_transition
data.value: {0} cannot move from {1} to {2}.

data.name: cl_err_429
data.value: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

data.name: cl_err_500
data.value: Something went wrong at our end.
data.comment: Never carries internal detail. The trace id in the response is how a developer finds the real error in the logs.

data.name: cl_err_001
data.value: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
data.comment: Refresh token unknown, expired, or already used.

data.name: cl_err_002
data.value: That phone number already has an account.

data.name: cl_equ_001
data.value: Bed {0} already exists in that ward.

data.name: cl_equ_002
data.value: Asset tag {0} is already in use.

data.name: cl_equ_003
data.value: That bed has a patient in it, or is being held for one, so it cannot be taken out of service.
data.comment: Answered from Patient Management inside the same request. Maintenance never evicts a patient.

data.name: cl_equ_004
data.value: An equipment category named {0} already exists.

data.name: cl_equ_005
data.value: Serial number {0} is already in use.

data.name: cl_equ_006
data.value: {0} is {1}, so it cannot be assigned. Only an available item can be.
data.comment: Covers already assigned, in maintenance and retired with one message.

data.name: cl_equ_007
data.value: {0} is not currently assigned to anyone.

data.name: cl_equ_008
data.value: A pharmacy category named {0} already exists.

data.name: cl_equ_009
data.value: A pharmacy item named {0} already exists.

data.name: cl_equ_010
data.value: Only {1} {2} of {0} on hand, so {3} cannot be taken.
data.comment: Raised by the conditional update, not by a prior read, so it is also what a losing race reports.

data.name: cl_equ_012
data.value: This maintenance task is already {0} and cannot be completed again.
data.comment: Overdue is not a blocker: it is stored as scheduled and only reads as overdue.

data.name: cl_equ_011
data.value: A stock adjustment needs a note saying why.
data.comment: Plan section 5.1: adjustments are stocktake corrections, and an unexplained one is unauditable.

data.name: cl_pat_001
data.value: A ward named {0} already exists.
data.comment: Only active wards are checked. A retired ward's name can be reused.

data.name: cl_pat_002
data.value: A patient with NIC {0} is already registered, as record {1}.
data.comment: Look the existing patient up instead of creating a second record for the same person.

data.name: cl_pat_003
data.value: This patient record already has a login linked to it.
data.comment: One account, one record. Unlink before relinking.

data.name: cl_pat_004
data.value: That login is already linked to another patient record.

data.name: cl_pat_005
data.value: Could not allocate a temporary reference. Try again.
data.comment: Only reachable if several unidentified arrivals are registered in the same instant and every retry collided.

data.name: cl_pat_006
data.value: {0} is already admitted. Continue their open visit rather than starting a second.
data.comment: One person, one stay at a time. Enforced by ux_admissions_open_patient, not only by the read that precedes it.

data.name: cl_pat_007
data.value: An emergency admission needs the dispatch reference from Emergency Service.
data.comment: Without it there is no link back to their record of the same journey.

data.name: cl_pat_008
data.value: No staff member {0} was found to record as having chosen the care level.

data.name: cl_pat_009
data.value: {0} already has a visit booked. Check them in or cancel it rather than booking a second.
data.comment: One open booking at a time, so the app cannot be used to hold several slots.

data.name: cl_pat_010
data.value: A visit cannot be booked for a time that has already passed.
data.comment: Always a typo at the desk. Somebody already here is admitted, not booked.

data.name: cl_pat_011
data.value: Only a duty manager may check a patient in at {0} level.
data.comment: Intensive and high-dependency care are the duty manager's to authorise, wherever the admission comes from.

data.name: cl_pat_012
data.value: Only a duty manager may assign a bed in {0} (ward type {1}).
data.comment: Intensive care and high dependency are the duty manager's wherever the request comes from. patient-management-plan.md 5.2.

data.name: cl_pat_013
data.value: {0} (ward type {1}) gives less intensive care than the {2} level this patient was assessed at. Only a duty manager may approve a downgrade.
data.comment: Giving somebody less care than a clinician asked for is a decision, and it is recorded as is_downgrade on the assignment.

data.name: cl_pat_014
data.value: Bed {0} has just been taken. Pick another.
data.comment: The honest answer to a race: two people assigned the same bed and ux_bed_assignments_live_bed refused the second.

data.name: cl_pat_015
data.value: Bed {0} is out of service.
data.comment: Hard rule H1. Equipment Management withdraws beds for repair and we never overrule that.

data.name: cl_pat_016
data.value: Bed {0} is in a ward of type {1}, which is more acute than the {2} care this patient needs.
data.comment: Hard rule H2 in the upward direction. Not generosity — it is the last ICU bed spent on somebody who does not need it.

data.name: cl_pat_017
data.value: Bed {0} is in a ward with a {1} gender policy, which does not admit a patient recorded as {2}.
data.comment: Hard rule H3. Gender separation is a property of the ward, so there is no emergency exception. A patient recorded as other or unknown reaches only a mixed ward.

data.name: cl_pat_018
data.value: This patient is infectious and bed {0} has no isolation.
data.comment: Hard rule H4. The flag is on the bed, not the ward — a side room is not only found in an isolation ward.

data.name: cl_pat_019
data.value: Bed {0} is in a ward that is no longer in service.
data.comment: Hard rule H5. The bed is real; its ward has been retired, so nobody can be admitted into it.

data.name: cl_pat_020
data.value: A {0} visit is discharged, not completed, because it has a bed to give back.
data.comment: POST /admissions/{id}/complete only finishes a visit that never needed a bed. Anything else is the discharge workflow.

data.name: cl_pat_021
data.value: A {0} visit does not need a bed.
data.comment: Hard rule H0. Refuses a bed assignment for an outpatient, who is seen and sent home.

data.name: cl_pat_022
data.value: {0} is ticked by a {1}, not by you.
data.comment: Discharge checklist. clinical_clearance is the doctor's alone; the rest belong to the ward nurse.

data.name: cl_pat_023
data.value: This discharge is not ready: {0} still outstanding.
data.comment: Every mandatory checklist item has to be ticked before a patient can be sent home.

data.name: cl_pat_024
data.value: Sending an {0} patient home is the duty manager's decision.
data.comment: A ward nurse confirms outpatient, day_case and inpatient discharges. ICU and HDU are one rung higher.

data.name: cl_pat_025
data.value: Tick billing_settled by settling the bill, not by hand.
data.comment: One fact in one place. Settling the bill is the only thing that writes this box, so a paid bill and an unticked box cannot happen.

data.name: cl_pat_026
data.value: Bill {0} is settled and cannot be changed.
data.comment: A settled bill is frozen: no new lines, no removals, no second settlement.

data.name: cl_pat_027
data.value: That line was worked out from the patient's stay and is not removable.
data.comment: Only a line somebody typed can be deleted. A bed or fee line changes by preparing the bill again.

data.name: cl_pat_028
data.value: This patient is not in a bed, so there is no bed to correct.
data.comment: Correcting a bed swaps a live assignment for another. With no live assignment there is nothing to swap, and the patient should simply be assigned a bed instead.

data.name: cl_pat_029
data.value: The patient is already in bed {0}.
data.comment: Correcting a bed to the one they are already in would release and re-take the same bed, losing the time they have been in it for no reason.
